caption: The drawing depicts a figure standing on a rectangular wooden platform, dressed in light yellow pants with red and green stripes on the sides and fringes at the cuffs. The figure wears a red garment with white stripes on the arms and has a yellow sash around the waist, with a quiver hanging from the left hip. Around the neck are layered necklaces, possibly made of beads. The figure has long black hair and an elaborate headdress made of several upright gray and white feathers with some brownish tones, held together by a red band. The right hand is raised to the face, with the index finger pointing to the cheek, while the left hand holds a bow, angled diagonally across the body. The figure’s feet are covered with dark footwear. The background is plain and off-white, with a subtle border around the main subject area. The name "Jacob Gielens" is inscribed beneath the platform in light gray text.
title: Doll
